opex.name: Operating expenses
opex.note: Research, engineering and running the business side of the fabs — TSMC reports this as one line in its earnings release.

footerNote: TSMC reports in New Taiwan dollars (revenue NT$989.9B; net income NT$452.3B). Dollar figures are converted at NT$29.91 per US$1 — implied by TSMC's own stated US-dollar revenue of $33.10B. Operating expenses are shown as one line, as in TSMC's earnings release, and segment dollars apply the platform percentages from TSMC's official earnings presentation to total revenue. The tax line is set so the flow lands on net income attributable to TSMC shareholders.
otherDetail: Non-operating income of NT$24.7B (about $0.8B) — mostly interest earned on TSMC's large cash pile.

takeaways.text: Chips made on 7-nanometer and more advanced processes were 74% of wafer revenue — 3nm alone was 23% as the newest process ramped, with 5nm at 37%.
takeaways.title: Leading edge is the business

takeaways.text: A gross margin of 59.5% and an operating margin of 50.6% mean TSMC kept about half of every revenue dollar after running the fabs.
takeaways.title: Margins near record levels

takeaways.text: Management guided fourth-quarter revenue to $32.2–33.4B with a gross margin of 59–61% — a touch below Q3's level, at a stronger assumed NT dollar.
takeaways.title: A slightly cooler Q4 ahead

verdict: TSMC's revenue rose 30% to NT$989.9B ($33.1B) on strong demand for its most advanced chips — and with a 59.5% gross margin, it kept NT$452.3B ($15.1B) as profit, up 39%.
